papers.abstract: Spatial gene expression results from the superposition of multiple sources of variation in gene expression across different spatial scales, including local microenvironment-associated variation and global spatial gradients. Spatial foundation models (SFMs) are large-scale machine learning models trained on cohorts of spatial transcriptomics (ST) data that, in principle, learn the different sources of spatial variation in gene expression. However, the embeddings learned by SFMs are difficult to interpret, and it remains unclear whether they fully capture such spatial variation. Here, we develop SAFFRON, a sparse autoencoder (SAE)-based framework for interpreting and evaluating SFMs. SAFFRON uses a Matryoshka SAE to decompose dense SFM embeddings into sparse, human-interpretable features and evaluates whether these features correlate with known sources of spatial variation. Using SAFFRON, we systematically benchmark the ability of several recent SFMs to identify local and global spatial variation in gene expression. We find that only two SFMs learn global spatial gradients more accurately than naive, non-foundation model baselines; further investigating one such SFM, SAFFRON reveals that these gradients are concentrated in a small subset of sparse, human-interpretable SAE features. On the other hand, no SFM learns local patterns (A{beta} plaque microenvironment-associated patterns) more accurately than such baselines. Our findings suggest that current SFMs do not systematically learn multi-scale spatial variation in gene expression. Code: SAFFRON is available at https://github.com/chitra-lab/SAFFRON.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SAFFRON 框架解释空间转录组基础模型（SFM）的嵌入，并发现当前 SFM 并未系统学习多尺度空间变异。
summary.methods: 用 Matryoshka 稀疏自编码器（SAE）将稠密 SFM 嵌入分解为稀疏、可解释特征，并评估其与已知空间变异来源的相关性；在多个近期 SFM 上系统基准测试局部与全局空间变异，包括 A{beta} 斑块微环境模式。
summary.relevance: 该研究评估空间基础模型所学表征是否真正捕获空间结构，直接服务于预训练主题中对基础模型表征能力的检验。
summary.caveat: 结论基于摘要所述基准与特定空间变异来源（全局梯度、A{beta} 斑块微环境），是否推广到其他组织与任务需原文确认；摘要未给出各模型的具体数值。

papers.title: Causal assessment of Bayesian gene regulatory networks from single-cell transcriptomics.
papers.abstract: Gene regulatory network (GRN) inference is an essential tool for revealing dysregulated relationships between genes in different cell types from single-cell transcriptomic (SCT) data. GRNs based on Bayesian networks (BNs) learned from SCT data can elucidate directed regulatory relationships representing complex disease mechanisms and their interplay through graphical modeling. However, software for learning BNs from SCT data is not widely available, nor is software for evaluating the BNs' structural accuracy in representing causal relationships between genes. Here, we describe the scstruc R package. This package provides a suite of BN structure learning algorithms specifically designed to handle SCT data, to evaluate the resulting networks based on the causal relationships they represent regardless of the availability of established molecular interaction networks, and to compare regulatory relationships between conditions. We demonstrated that scstruc can identify biologically relevant differential regulatory relationships between groups on a per-cell basis.

summary.takeaway: 介绍 scstruc R 包，为单细胞转录组数据提供贝叶斯网络结构学习与因果结构准确性评估工具。
summary.methods: 提供一套面向 SCT 数据的 BN 结构学习算法，并可在无需已有分子互作网络的情况下评估所得网络所代表的因果关系，还支持比较不同条件下的调控关系；在单细胞层面展示差异调控关系的识别。
summary.relevance: 该工具直接服务于 GRN/Regulon 主题，即从单细胞转录组推断基因调控网络并评估其因果结构。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告与其他 GRN 推断方法的定量比较或基准数据集结果；因果评估的有效性依赖贝叶斯网络假设，具体限制需见原文。

papers.title: ReliFlow: Reliability-Calibrated Residual Transport for Combinatorial Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response to combined perturbations requires distinguishing interactions between interventions from errors in their individual effect estimates. The latter become more pronounced when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld. We introduce a conditional flow-matching model that estimates the reliability of single-gene effects from training-only cross-fitting and uses those estimates to calibrate the additive source distribution. The velocity is decomposed into a known correction of the additive reference and a learned residual transport field. On Norman genetic perturbations, reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.142 to 0.131 for unseen combinations of observed singles and from 0.198 to 0.178 when constituent singles are withheld. On held-out ComboSciPlex drug combinations, MAE decreases from 0.191 to 0.176. Non-additive residual correlation improves from 0.574 to 0.638, and component ablations identify the contribution of reliability weighting. The results indicate that accounting for uncertain constituent effects improves generalization to unseen genetic and chemical combinations, with a moderate increase in training cost.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ReliFlow，通过估计单基因效应的可靠性来校准加性参考，从而改进对未见组合扰动的转录响应预测。
summary.methods: 采用条件流匹配模型，用仅训练集的交叉拟合估计单基因效应可靠性并据此校准加性源分布，将速度分解为对加性参考的已知校正与学习的残差传输场；在 Norman 遗传扰动和 ComboSciPlex 药物组合上评估并做组件消融。
summary.relevance: 该工作聚焦单细胞扰动主题中组合扰动的响应预测，强调区分干预间交互与单效应估计误差。
summary.caveat: 仅在 Norman 和 ComboSciPlex 两个数据集上验证，且摘要提到训练成本有中等程度增加；泛化到其他扰动类型与平台需进一步验证。

papers.title: Root gene regulatory network analysis reveals roles for defense hormones and secondary metabolites in establishment of disease-suppressive soil.
papers.abstract: Plants recruit beneficial microbiota in their rhizosphere to alleviate stresses. In Arabidopsis thaliana, foliar infection by Hyaloperonospora arabidopsidis (Hpa) has been shown to establish a disease-suppressive microbiome that promotes protection against Hpa infection of the subsequent plant generation grown in conditioned soil - a phenomenon known as soil-borne legacy (SBL). The root responses involved in SBL establishment have remained largely unclear. In this study, time-series RNA-seq of roots from Hpa-infected plants grown in natural soil was conducted over 7 d post inoculation. A gene regulatory network of the responding roots was constructed. The role of predicted key components was verified in follow-up assays. Root transcriptional reprogramming started within 1 d after foliar infection. Genes associated with salicylic acid (SA)-mediated defense were upregulated, while those linked to secondary metabolism and jasmonic acid (JA) responsiveness were downregulated. SA accumulation increased at 1 d post inoculation (dpi), and JA decreased by 3 dpi. Transcriptional regulation occurred in the tips of the roots. Mutant analyses confirmed that SA, JA, indole glucosinolates, camalexin, and flavonoids contribute to SBL establishment. Our findings reveal systemic transcriptional reprogramming in roots upon foliar pathogen attack, uncovering roles of hormone signaling and secondary metabolism in shaping a disease-suppressive soil beyond their known defense functions.

summary.takeaway: 通过根基因调控网络分析，揭示防御激素与次生代谢物在建立抑病土壤（soil-borne legacy）中的作用。
summary.methods: 对 Hpa 侵染植株在自然土壤中的根进行接种后 7 天时间序列 RNA-seq，构建响应根的基因调控网络，并用后续实验验证预测的关键组分；结合突变体分析检验 SA、JA、吲哚硫苷、camalexin 和类黄酮的贡献。
summary.relevance: 该研究属于 GRN/Regulon 主题，展示从时间序列转录组构建调控网络并实验验证关键节点的流程。
summary.caveat: 为该特定植物-病原-土壤体系的研究，结论外推到其他物种或微生物组情境需谨慎；摘要未给出网络推断的统计性能指标。

papers.title: Hypnos: A Dual-Phase End-to-End Platform for Scalable Continual Learning at the Edge
papers.abstract: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Hypnos，一个受清醒/睡眠周期启发的双阶段端到端平台，用于在边缘设备上实现可扩展的持续学习。
summary.methods: 清醒阶段在 RISC-V MCU 的低占用 SoC 上做高效推理与轻量无梯度原型更新；睡眠阶段由智能充电器执行基于回放的梯度更新以巩固知识；在 ZCU104 FPGA 上实现并按 28nm 工艺综合，于 CORe50 NICv2-391 协议上基准测试。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接对应持续学习主题，探索在资源受限边缘设备上缓解灾难性遗忘的部署方案。
summary.caveat: 评估限于 CORe50 这一协议，摘要未说明对其他数据流或硬件平台的适用性；睡眠阶段依赖外部充电/计算资源，实际部署约束需见原文。

papers.title: Learning with Unlearning: Synaptic Role Partitioning for Simultaneous Continual Learning and Machine Unlearning
papers.abstract: Continual Learning (CL) asks a model to acquire new knowledge without forgetting what it already knows. Machine Unlearning (MU) asks it to destroy specific knowledge without damaging the rest. The challenge is integrating them in the same system; the two objectives pull on the same weights, and an edit made for one harms the other. To address this, we propose Learning with Unlearning (LwU), a unified framework that resolves the conflict where it occurs: at the individual synapse. LwU scores every weight twice, once against the data to keep and once against the data to delete, and partitions the network into four zones with separate update rules. Weights that only require retention are frozen. Weights that only require deletion are cleared and returned to the network as free capacity. Contested weights take a gradient-ascent step projected orthogonally to the retention gradient. The remaining capacity learns the incoming task by a privileged teacher via self-distillation. Deletion is served post hoc, and no retraining is required. Across both CL and MU jobs, LwU outperforms or matches the strongest baseline. Its real-world practicality has been demonstrated on the Physical Artificial Intelligence (PAI) dataset we conducted. Additionally, in the image generation task and in removing dangerous content, it outperformed the closest baseline, as shown in Fig.1.

summary.takeaway: 提出 LwU 统一框架，在单个突触层面为持续学习与机器遗忘划分角色，以缓解两个目标的冲突。
summary.methods: 对每个权重分别针对保留数据与删除数据打分，将网络划分为四个区域并施加不同更新规则（冻结、清除并回收容量、对保留梯度正交投影的梯度上升等），剩余容量通过特权教师自蒸馏学习新任务；在 CL 与 MU 任务及 PAI 数据集上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作同时涉及持续学习与机器遗忘，属于持续学习主题下对知识获取与定向删除统一处理的研究。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要报告相对最强基线的优劣而未给出具体数值；评估集中在图像分类、图像生成和危险内容移除等任务，其他模态与更复杂任务序列下的表现需原文确认。

papers.title: UCLIR: Unsupervised Continual Learning using Independent Representations
papers.abstract: In continual learning, regularization-based methods aim to mimic neuroplasticity by updating network weights to learn new tasks while constraining changes to parameters that are important for previously learned tasks through penalty terms. However, as the number of tasks increases, preserving knowledge from earlier tasks becomes less effective. This is mainly because updates for new tasks are distributed across the entire network, where parameters are highly interdependent due to the dense connectivity between neurons. Inspired by the Exponential Distance Rule (EDR), which states that the number of neural connections decreases with increasing physical distance, learning is naturally locally correlated while inter-area updates remain less task-dependent. Motivated by this principle, in this paper we demonstrate that applying weight regularization to multiple small and independently learned complementary representations is more effective than regularizing a single large shared representation. By decomposing the input into independently learned components, learning new tasks induces only localized parameter updates within specific representation, which limit interference and improve knowledge retention across tasks. We employ independent autoencoders that learn different parts of the input independently through unsupervised regularization. At inference time, a linear classifier is used for evaluation. The experimental results on a sequence of tasks using 5-Splits MNIST, sequence of 5-datasets, 5-Splits CIFAR-10, 10-Splits Tiny ImageNet shows competitive results with supervised and replay-based methods. Code is available.

summary.takeaway: 提出 UCLIR，用多个独立学习的互补表征替代单一共享表征进行正则化，从而改善持续学习中的知识保留。
summary.methods: 受指数距离规则（EDR）启发，用独立自编码器通过无监督正则分别学习输入的不同部分，推理时接线性分类器；在 5-Splits MNIST、5-datasets 序列、5-Splits CIFAR-10 和 10-Splits Tiny ImageNet 上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于持续学习主题，探索基于正则化的无监督持续学习以减轻任务间干扰。
summary.caveat: 推理阶段依赖线性分类器评估，且实验限于图像分类基准；摘要称结果与有监督及基于回放的方法具有竞争力，但未给出具体数值，也未讨论更长时间任务序列下的退化。

papers.title: Engineered post-transcriptional regulation of Scn10a by Pumilio ameliorates neuropathic pain in mice
papers.abstract: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA permeates biology, yet its contribution to sensory neuron physiology and pain remains unclear. The mammalian Pumilio proteins PUM1 and PUM2 (collectively referred to as PUM) are RNA-binding proteins that bind Pumilio response elements (PREs), typically situated in 3' untranslated regions. PUM recruits the CCR4-NOT complex to promote mRNA deadenylation and decay. Several mRNAs that encode voltage-gated sodium channels that regulate action potential generation in pain sensing neurons harbor PREs. Here, we explored whether PUM plays a role in pain signaling. PUM1 and PUM2 were enriched in TRPV1-positive dorsal root ganglion neurons, where PUM2 physically interacted with Scn9a, Scn10a, and Scn11a transcripts, which encode Nav1.7, Nav1.8, and Nav1.9, respectively. Depletion of PUM in sensory neurons produced mechanical hypersensitivity and enhanced inflammatory pain. These effects were reversed by blocking Nav1.8 but not Nav1.7, raising the possibility that repression of Scn10a by PUM can be harnessed using synthetic biology to diminish neuropathic pain. To this end, we generated a chimera comprising the RNA-binding domain of PUM2 and a repressive domain, which we dubbed "super-PUM". Expression of AAV-encoded super-PUM in sensory neurons reduced Nav1.8 abundance, diminished tetrodotoxin-resistant and suzetrigine-sensitive sodium currents, and prevented mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity following spared nerve injury. These results demonstrate that optimization of an endogenous post-transcriptional regulon provides a means to ameliorate neuropathic pain.

summary.takeaway: PUM1/PUM2 通过结合 Scn9a/Scn10a/Scn11a 的 PRE 抑制钠通道表达；作者据此构建 PUM2 RNA 结合域与抑制域融合的“super-PUM”，用 AAV 递送至感觉神经元可降低 Nav1.8 并缓解神经损伤后痛敏。
summary.methods: 在 TRPV1 阳性 DRG 神经元中检测 PUM1/PUM2 富集及 PUM2 与 Scn9a、Scn10a、Scn11a 转录本的物理互作；用感觉神经元 PUM 缺失观察机械痛敏和炎症痛，并以 Nav1.8、Nav1.7 阻断验证通路；构建 AAV 编码的 super-PUM，检测 Nav1.8 丰度、TTX 抗性和 suzetrigine 敏感钠电流及 spared nerve injury 后的机械与热痛敏。
summary.relevance: 该工作将内源转录后调控子（PUM-PRE 调控模块）工程化为可递送的抑制工具，属于合成生物学改造内源调控网络/regulon 的思路，与 GRN/Regulon 主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要基于小鼠模型，未给出长期表达的安全性、脱靶转录本范围及临床转化可行性；super-PUM 对其他 PRE 靶标的影响未说明。
